presentation.limitation: Three AgX is not the Blender Medium High Contrast look transform.

runtimeArtistOverride.reason: Approved golden twilight; sun approximately at panorama longitude .746 / elevation 4.6 degrees. No native lighting parity claim.

area.name: ART cool fill
area.conversion: Disk to equal-area rectangle. Source radiant power/(pi*area) used as initial numeric radiance; Three photometric calibration and shadows differ.

lighting.limitations: Approved artist twilight calibration in Three. Historical sourceBlender fields are provenance of the earlier setup, not the current runtime overrides. No native S5Runtime lighting parity claim.

background.orientation: Three standard equirectangular, rotationY0. Source Blender texture has no explicit mapping rotation; pixel orientation parity not certified.

uvPolicy: Native SCN UV0 direct V/top-left. Color atlases and alpha PNGs retain native DDS orientation. Both color and alpha samplers use flipY=false. No geometry UV or PNG pixels changed.
lightmapPolicy: The exported Blender Base Color graph is authoritative; no additional native lightmap is multiplied by the runtime.
stage: Golden twilight polish: existing structures, detailed floors, bounded LED spill, four foliage accents and background-only tower continuation. Native parity remains unqualified.

reconstruction.stage: Strong zoned material and decorative refit v6; native readiness remains separately qualified.

shadows.qualification: Artist sun direction preserved; one bounded 2048 shadow map, source collision and geometry untouched. Hardware main-game review required.

ambient.sourceReference: s01_m002_c0122; source table AABB center with artistic height offset; no collider

towerIllusionProvenance.material: Exact existing AZIT / warm mineral concrete ImageGen PNG, not the rejected office facade.
towerIllusionProvenance.qualification: Artist facade analytically sampled inside the existing panorama; no new mesh, object or collider below the map. Native bottom contour retained.
